title: Kenyan Kissed Grilled Steak
description: A flavorful and spicy grilled steak dish inspired by Kenyan cuisine. The combination of flavors and spices will leave you wanting more.

ingredients.name: Kenyan Kissed spice blend (available at local African markets)

instructions: Season the steak with salt, pepper, and a pinch of Kenyan Kissed spice blend.
Brush the grill with coconut oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the steak for 4-5 minutes per side, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
Transfer the steak to a plate and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, grill the pineapple rings for 2-3 minutes per side, or until caramelized.
Slice the steak against the grain and serve with grilled pineapple, a sprinkle of cilantro, and a squeeze of lime juice.
